acts.label: Prologue
Act One
acts.desc:
Samantha Broun interviews her mom about surviving a brutal attack by Reginald McFadden 20 years ago, and sets out to interview friends, family and policymakers about how that attack changed Pennsylvania law regarding life sentences at the time.
Additional information and outtakes are available on the Transom website.

songs.t: Doin’ Time (Tricked Out Life Sentence Remix)

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Samantha continues toward McFadden, and talks to an inmate who knows something about the case that she never knew before.
